purpose: Single source of truth for role -> model resolution. Built because three sources (MODEL_ROUTING_V1.md, tools/hal_driver.py, .claude/memory.md) disagreed about HAL's model with nobody having reconciled it. Every call site and skill file should resolve through this registry (tools/model_registry.py), not hardcode a literal tag.
note: This registry does NOT itself change any running code's default. tools/hal_driver.py still defaults to deepseek-r1:14b, contradicting the resolution below. That is a live behavior change on a governance-role component and is flagged, not silently patched -- needs explicit operator GO.

HAL.rationale: MODEL_ROUTING_V1.md section 3+7 (binding, adopted 2026-05-15): HAL is a strict governance-role gate; a creative/reasoning model 'tries to reason its way around the rules instead of just applying them'. deepseek-r1 is explicitly named as a forbidden pattern for this role.

contradicting_sources.note: the spec's own named-forbidden pattern, live default
third answer, no rationale given, 'metal-verified' against a live daemon observation, not reconciled with the binding spec

HAL.action_needed: operator decision: (a) fix hal_driver.py to match the binding spec (mistral:latest), or (b) amend the spec if deepseek-r1 or gemma4:e2b is now the intended choice for a documented reason. Currently neither -- it's drift, not decision.

HER.rationale: Consistent across both sources: creative proposer role wants generation diversity over strict compliance.

GOBLIN.rationale: Mutator/miner role, not present in MODEL_ROUTING_V1.md (predates GOBLIN's naming) -- resolved from .claude/memory.md metal-verified map only, no independent second source to cross-check against.
GOBLIN.gap: no documented rationale for why gemma4:latest specifically fits the GOBLIN role -- worth writing one down next time this is touched

HELEN_narrator.rationale: Voice/narration role, uses the HELEN-specific fine-tune.
HELEN_narrator.gap: ornith-helen:v4 passed its eval gate and is registered but unpromoted (per .claude/memory.md decisions log) -- this role still points at v1. Promoting v4 requires an operator .env repoint, explicitly not automated here.

JESTER.rationale: Default per --model flag, same call shape as the Temple HAL judge.

CLAW.rationale: EXECUTION layer should not be an LLM -- deterministic tool dispatcher. Both sources agree this is correct, not a gap.

KERNEL.gap: memory.md notes 'mistral:latest still lingers here (half-migration)' -- an unfinished migration, not a resolved state. Flagged, not fixed here.

mesh_REASONING.note: this is the ONE role where deepseek-r1 is correctly assigned -- REASONING, not the strict HAL gate. The HAL contradiction above is specifically about the role mismatch, not the model being bad in general.

barbell_default_miner.rationale: Operator-stated preference, 2026-07-02, for general local gruntwork across the newer skill system -- not part of the original per-agent MODEL_ROUTING_V1.md map, a separate later tier.
